data.title: Hop Back on the Number Line
data.description: Learn how to subtract numbers by hopping backward on a fun number line from 0 to 10.

challenges.instruction: Can you find and place a point at 2 on our number line?
challenges.hint: Start at 0 and hop forward two little steps to find your spot!

challenges.instruction: Place a point at 9 on the number line.
challenges.hint: Find the number 8 right before the end, and take one more hop forward to the next tick mark.

challenges.instruction: Place a point at the number 8 on the number line.
challenges.hint: Look for the number right after 7 and right before 9.

challenges.instruction: Can you show me where the very beginning of the number line is by placing a point at 0?
challenges.hint: Look all the way to the left of the number line, right before you start counting up with 1.

challenges.instruction: Can you find the number that comes right after five? Place a point there!
challenges.hint: Look at five, and take one little hop forward to find your spot.
